title: TFLN rib waveguide modes and dispersion (x-cut, 1500-1600 nm)
description:
Thin-film lithium niobate (LNOI) rib waveguide cross-section: a 600 nm x-cut film (t_film) etched 300 nm deep (t_etch) to a 1.2 um wide rib top (w_top) with 60 degree sidewalls (sidewall_deg, 90 = vertical), on a silica buried oxide, air above (n_top = 1; 1.444 gives a silica overclad).
Axes and crystal cut: em_modes treats xy as the cross-section (x horizontal, y up along the film normal) and z as the propagation direction. The film is x-cut and the light travels along crystal y, so the optic axis (crystal z) lies horizontal in the cross-section: eps_xx = n_e^2 (2.138^2 = 4.571), eps_yy = eps_zz = n_o^2 (2.211^2 = 4.889). The quasi-TE mode (E along x) therefore sees n_e and uses r33, the usual electro-optic layout. The library material lithium_niobate_z_cut is not used: it names z the out-of-plane axis of the in-plane 2D models (eps_zz = n_e^2), which is the propagation axis here; the three components are set explicitly from the parameters n_o and n_e instead. Other cuts: z-cut eps_yy = n_e^2, eps_xx = eps_zz = n_o^2; x-cut z-propagating eps_zz = n_e^2, eps_xx = eps_yy = n_o^2. Constant indices: no LN or silica material dispersion.
Half domain: the rib is mirror symmetric about its centre, which lies on the x min mirror plane (the domain edge x = 0; its ghost cell is added outside); antisymmetric keeps the quasi-TE family (E_x even about the plane) with half the unknowns. Set x min to symmetric for the quasi-TM family; TM-like modes of shallow ribs can leak into the TE mode of the etched slab, which shows as loss_db_per_cm > 0. The buried oxide and the slab run into the PML (no silicon substrate, so no substrate leakage).
Study: frequency_domain at 1500-1600 nm in 20 nm steps with 1550 nm solved last, so the Mode table, the derived values read from it and the displayed field are at 1550 nm. mode_dispersion follows mode 1 (quasi-TE0) by overlap (Curves & tables tab: n_eff and n_group vs wavelength; n_g_1500 / n_g_1600 in the Derived values tab). Compute group index is on (3 eigen-solves per wavelength). Mesh: uniform 20 nm, about 6e4 unknowns; dx_cell 10 nm gives about 2.2e5 and a finer sidewall staircase.
Expected (effective-index estimate, not a closed form): TE0 n_eff about 1.88-1.91, n_g about 2.2-2.3 (no material dispersion; real LN adds roughly 0.05-0.1), te_fraction close to 1, effective area of order 1 um^2. Further table rows are slab (radiation) modes of the etched region held by the window, n_eff about 1.74 or below, with a visible pml_fraction.
Parameters to sweep: w_top, t_etch, sidewall_deg, n_top (air vs silica cladding), dx_cell (it must divide t_box, t_film, t_etch, t_top, w_top / 2 and w_window).

parameters.name: n_o
parameters.description: ordinary index of LN at 1550 nm (library lithium_niobate_z_cut value)

parameters.name: n_e
parameters.description: extraordinary index of LN at 1550 nm (along the optic axis)

parameters.name: n_top
parameters.description: top cladding index: 1 = air, 1.444 = silica overclad

parameters.name: t_etch
parameters.description: etch depth (slab left beside the rib: t_film - t_etch)

parameters.name: sidewall_deg
parameters.description: sidewall angle to the substrate plane in degrees (90 = vertical)

parameters.name: t_box
parameters.description: buried oxide inside the window (continues into the PML)

parameters.name: t_top
parameters.description: top cladding above the film top (continues into the PML)

parameters.name: w_window
parameters.description: lateral window from the mirror plane to the x max PML

parameters.name: x_mirror
parameters.description: rib centre = x min mirror plane (the domain edge)
